items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: The name 'Allie' appears only as a form of address by the interviewer to the interviewee (Alex Bigard). There is no mention of a third person named 'Allie' in the transcript.

ctx.x: You call it ragtime. That's what you call it ragtime music. But Dixieland music... Da da da da... Da da da da... Da da da da... See what do you call it? Da da da da da... Da da da da...
That's ragtime music. That's two different kinds of beats right there. Well that's slower music. I imagine it would be better to dance to, would it not, Allie?

Well yeah, it's better to dance with Ant and you, and the man gonna harmonize, gonna make this part just right. In other words he doesn't have to do it. See now we played, we used to play Tiger Rag, not like they play, we played da da da da da da da da da. See? That was Dixieland. Da da da da da da da da da da. Da da da da da da da da. Da da da da da. Give a man a chance to make these parts, gonna make it right. When you do that right time music, that's two different kinds of music all together. Not to say you…
